description:
Use this when the user wants clips cut from a long video: "find the highlights in my stream", "turn my VOD
into TikToks". Cuts the moments that stand on their own into vertical captioned clips framed on the speaker.
Not for: one exact stretch (clip_range), a search by meaning (find_moments) or changing a clip (edit_clip).
Spends Horizon Units: estimate_hu first, and pass the number the user approved as max_hu (a failed job gives
them back). Returns job_id for job_status.

ai_titles.description: Title, post caption and hashtags per clip

clipping_preset.description: Id or name from list_clipping_presets; empty = your default, "none" = standard look

hook_first_version.description: Add one extra clip opening on its strongest seconds

max_hu.description: HU the user approved after estimate_hu; a higher cost is refused

range_end.description: End in seconds; 0 = to the end

range_start.description: Start in seconds; 0 = from the start

topic.description: Words that must be spoken, e.g. "the new game"; empty = any

name: find_clips
title: Find clips
